system.description:
You reach out and attempt to destabilize the cellular structure of your foe, while also trying to absorb these destabilized cells through your Nature Energy. Target creature must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they gain 2 ranks of Weakened, and you regain 5d6 hit points.

Amplify: By spending 3 Natural Energy as part of this jutsu’s casting, you magnify the power of this ability, allowing you to also drain the targets Chakra. On a failure, the target take chakra damage equal the hit points you regained and you gain temporary chakra points equal to half your level.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank above C-Rank you cast this jutsu, increase the cost by 3 and the amount of hit points regained by 1d6. If this just is cast at A-Rank or higher, increase the ranks of Weakened inflicted by +1.
